candidates.title: Missing/Damaged report per branch
candidates.statement: The system shall provide reports of missing and damaged items per branch.
candidates.source_quote: System provides reports of missing and damaged items per branch.
candidates.priority_signals: Maria: "I need this for my inventory audit and for collection management." Latoya: "That's crucial for accountability."

candidates.title: In-transit items report (threshold)
candidates.statement: The system shall generate a list of items that have been in-transit for more than X days, available per branch and per system.
candidates.source_quote: System generates a list of items in-transit for more than X days (X configurable), per branch and per system.
candidates.priority_signals: Dana: "Oh, we definitely need the in-transit report too."

candidates.title: Configurable in-transit threshold
candidates.statement: The system shall allow the threshold X (number of days used to flag items as in-transit for more than X days) to be configurable.
candidates.priority_signals: Susan: "X configurable"; Dana: "X should be configurable"

candidates.title: Default in-transit threshold 7 days
candidates.statement: The system shall default the in-transit threshold X to 7 days unless a user changes the configuration.
candidates.source_quote: X should be configurable, probably 7 days default.

candidates.title: Merge transit-to and transit-from
candidates.statement: The system shall merge transit-to and transit-from records into a single in-transit report so front-line staff do not have to run two reports.
candidates.source_quote: the report should merge transit-to and transit-from so front-line staff don't have to run two reports.
candidates.priority_signals: Dana: "so front-line staff don't have to run two reports." Susan and Katherine reiterated merged report in summary.

candidates.title: Sort in-transit report by due date
candidates.statement: The system shall allow the in-transit report to be sorted by due date so staff can chase the oldest items first.
candidates.source_quote: can we sort by due date? Front-line staff need to chase the oldest items first.
candidates.priority_signals: Susan explicitly: "Front-line staff need to chase the oldest items first."

candidates.title: Date range filters for missing/damaged report
candidates.statement: The system shall allow date-range selection (for example, last 30 days or last quarter) when generating missing and damaged items reports to support trending.
candidates.source_quote: The missing/damaged report can include date ranges (e.g., last 30 days, last quarter, etc.) which would be useful for trending.
candidates.priority_signals: Robert: "which would be useful for trending."

candidates.title: Include item condition notes
candidates.statement: The system shall include item condition notes (for example "water damage" or "vandalism") in the missing and damaged items report.
candidates.source_quote: Can the report include item condition notes? Like "water damage" or "vandalism"?
candidates.priority_signals: Latoya: "That helps us understand root causes."

candidates.title: Filter by item status
candidates.statement: The system shall allow the missing/damaged report to include or filter items by item status values such as "missing", "lost", or "long overdue".
candidates.source_quote: we can query for items with status "missing" or "lost" and group by branch.
candidates.priority_signals: Robert: technical note about available statuses.

candidates.title: Counts and grouping by branch for auditing
candidates.statement: The system shall provide counts of missing and damaged items grouped by branch to support auditing and accountability.
candidates.source_quote: Auditing - showing how many items went missing/were damaged
candidates.priority_signals: George: auditing purpose; Latoya: "crucial for accountability."

candidates.title: Trending capability for reports
candidates.statement: The system shall provide trending capabilities for missing and damaged items over selectable time ranges to inform collection management decisions.
candidates.source_quote: which would be useful for trending... for collection decisions - if we keep losing the same titles
candidates.priority_signals: George: use for collection decisions; Robert: trending useful.

candidates.title: Identify repeat-lost titles
candidates.statement: The system shall identify titles that have repeated missing or damage incidents to support collection decisions such as replacing copies or moving locations.
candidates.source_quote: if we keep losing the same titles, maybe we need different copies or to move them to a different location
candidates.priority_signals: George: explicit use-case for collection decisions.

candidates.title: In-transit detection rule (data constraint)
candidates.statement: The system shall identify in-transit items by checking the transit table for records where arrival date is null and the departure date is more than X days ago.
candidates.source_quote: check the transit table for items where the arrival date is null and the departure date is more than X days ago.
candidates.priority_signals: Robert provided this as the technical method to detect in-transit items.

candidates.title: Document reports separately
candidates.statement: The system documentation shall record the Missing and Damaged Items report and the In-Transit Items report as two separate requirements/entries.
candidates.source_quote: These are two separate but related requirements. Let's track them separately in our documentation.
candidates.priority_signals: Katherine: "Both will be added to the requirements list." Susan: asked to track separately.
